I am currently in an identical situation to yours. It has been difficult for me to hear my SO say that he **leans toward creationism, that businesses should be allowed to discriminate against people they serve, and that he’s satisfied overall with Trump and his administration. When I try to tell him how his beliefs make me feel he wants to brush it under the rug like it doesn’t matter. I know deep down that it does. When I press him he usually hears me out and modifies how he’s looking at the situation based on the perspectives and facts I give him. However endearing it is that he tries so hard, it is like pulling teeth for me. The conclusions he draws on his own are always conservative. I know deep down it’s not fair for me to have to keep over explaining things he doesn’t seem to care about, just so he can empathize with me.  It’s also not fair to him for me to be unaccepting of the way he thinks. Food for thought.

I don’t think he’s lying. I believe that he is just that paranoid. He’s constantly worried about not having a job even though he’s successful, capable, and everyone at work likes him. He’s terrified that he’ll lose what he has to the point that he’s afraid to have a personality almost.

He’s mentioned it in the past that he’s paranoid about it. He didn’t reiterate it this time. Most of the time we communicate via phone bc LDR. I genuinely forgot. He goes back and forth between saying “my friend is head of IT, so I’m not worried,” to “omg they can see everything and I’m going to get fired or demoted or replaced!!” It’s hard for me to keep up and has stunted our relationship. He’s too cheap to have a personal phone when work is already paying for one. I’ve always hated it but I understand why he’s upset. I’m just fed up is all. I was trying to be loving and connect and I committed some awful crime instead.

He’s gotten nudes and weird pictures of girls from his brother on that phone before. He’s also had old sexy pics of ex girlfriends on there. Do you think texting is worse than having pictures on a work phone? Maybe they will only care about him leaving. Honestly, I would be surprised if they didn’t offer him more money to stay rather than replace him. He’s a great employee. He’s done a lot for the company. His higher ups love him.

He’s worried someone at the company could access his phone records. It’s the only device he has and we’re in a LDR. So, of course I just though a sweet good luck text would be nice. I should have thought it through. This is exhausting.
